\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{luacode}
\begin{document}
\begin{luacode*}
local f=require('format')
local v=dofile(os.getenv('CV_DATA_FILE')).values
tex.print('\\section*{'..f.text(v.fullName)..'}')
tex.print(f.text(v.mail)..'\\par')
for _,entry in ipairs(v.career or {}) do
 tex.print('\\subsection*{'..f.text(entry.values.position)..'}')
 f.blocks(entry.values.body)
end
\end{luacode*}
\end{document}
